content: Ha luluwaley le hamem ha kekabos irel yamem kekapta meka kofmem? Hamem ila hate wochog ikla sibis, bo tor pelal le be yor babior le be sor kofmem. Ngo wol tor pelal le hami habe ffaor babior bo habe kapta kofmem ngalir ikla sibis.
Hami mele hasa mel le yamem babior le ye teftaf lal meka depmem, bo pangal yarmat ngo be yoh le rebe gola ngo re yawli.

Ye lleloh le Kristus mele ye spegil tefa babior le hamem hasa fang. Babior le ila te teftaf ngal ink, bo Espritu Santus la lamliyel Deus le yema fang molow mele ye tefa, ngo yete tefa wol madpil feas bo ye tefa long lal deper yarmat.
Ha sor mele bo fael mala ye tugul lal depmem irel Deus le fael Kristus.
Tor igegmem le habe sor bo be yoh le habe yangtali yengang ka. Deus mele ye fang kkelmem bo be yoh le habe foru yengang ka.

Iy mele ye fang kkelmem bo be yoh le habe foru yangangel bogtag we ye tefoy, le yete mo irel hatobtob we ye teftaf lal babior, bo ye budoh mo irel Espritu Santus. Hatobtob la ye teftaf lal babior ila yema hasidoh maes. Iwe ngo Espritu Santus ila yema fang molow.

Hatobtob we ila ye teftaf wol rumadep feas, iwe ngo ye llahloh mala falmayel Deus irel yodwe ye fang Hatobtob we iyang. Ila mwo yesa mmaludoh kkel werel wol molwe metael Moses, ngo yeted mmal chog le yarmetael Israel kowe rebe kalngali. Hare ila lepal kkelel falmay la yael Deus le ye llah irel yodwe ye fang Hatobtob we ye hasidoh maes,
ila ngo yebe kkel tot falmayel bogtag la ye tefoy le yael Espritu Santus.
Hare ye kkel werel mala ye hasidoh hagerger, ila ngo yebe far kkel tot werel ila ye hasidoh molow!
Be yoh le sibe sor bo tayor loh momayel falmay we igawe bo yagel mala yesa kkel hemas momayel falmay le igla.
Bo hare yor falmayel bogtag we te ssulay, ila ngo yebe far palleng tot falmayel Bogtag le tor siyal.
Hamem ha luglug irel mele. Ila fal le ye kkel depmem bo habe kapta mele.
Hamem ila hate wochog Moses we ye pelat woal metal ngal sedep mengag bo re Israel kowe rede wiri yal chuchuloh werel wol molwe metal.

Re Israel kowe re temedaf irel molwe. Ralleka mwo ngo ye wochog bo chil pelat chog yar luluwal irel semadep mengag irel yodka rema yawli babiorol bogtag we muswe. Yodla semal yebe Kristiano iyang mele yebe moch chuy mengag la ma pelta yal luluwal.
Igla mwo ngo yodka rebe yawli Hatobtob we yael Moses ngo madpil mengag le, ila ye chil pelta luluwal kala yar.
Ngo ligdi bo yebe yoh le be chuy, le be wochog molwe babior we ye santus ye sor irel Moses bo, “Ye chuy madpil mengag we mo wol metal Moses irel yodwe ye tagul sa kalngal Samol.”
Samol ila Espritu Santus, iwe ngo semal le ye mel Espritu Santus la lamli yael Samol irel, iwe ngo iy ila ye taldag.

Ila pangachloh ngo ye llah mala falmayel Deus mo uwoch le te pilta wol metach. Falmay le ye budoh mo irel Samol le iy Espritu Santus, mele ye foru bo yebe kekkel loh yach igegeli iy Samol luwul falmay.
